label: TP
reason: User-supplied Referer header flows directly into HTML response body via response.getWriter().write(bar) without any HTML entity encoding or context-aware escaping. The X-XSS-Protection header being disabled confirms intentional bypass of browser defenses, leaving unencoded script tags from the Referer executable in the page.

evidence.note: User input extracted from Referer header and written to response body without sanitization
